author: Axion Team
description: Manage apache2: sites, confs, modules, logs, SSL certs, and the main config, with auto-test, diff, backups, and live status.
name: Apache2 Manager

settings.name: logLines
settings.title: Log lines to tail
settings.description: How many lines to fetch when opening a log.

settings.name: liveIntervalMs
settings.title: Live refresh interval (ms)
settings.description: Polling interval for live log tail and status auto-refresh.

settings.name: backupCount
settings.title: Backups to keep per file
settings.description: Older backups beyond this are pruned. 0 disables backups.

settings.name: autoPollStatus
settings.title: Auto-poll daemon status
settings.description: Refresh the daemon status pill periodically.
